Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Interface FaceSearchApi

public interface FaceSearchApi

  • Method Details

    • startCameraSearch

      @NonNull FaceSearchSession startCameraSearch(@NonNull FaceSearchSessionConfig config, @NonNull FaceSearchListener listener)
      Mutually exclusive with capture, liveness, verification, and other camera-search flows on the same SDK. Returns a session immediately while the SDK opens the application face library, prepares models, and warms up the configured group/tag scope in the background. Frames submitted during preparation are discarded and processFrame returns NOT_READY. Search starts automatically when ready. Opening or preparation failures are reported through onError; fix the cause and call Session.resume() to retry. Closing the Session or SDK releases its search connection automatically.
